description: VERIFIED subset of the 273/multi-category doping cascade (tools/doping) results, copied to the vm repo so they are queryable here. The FULL registered cascade (39+ compounds) lives in doping_cascade.json on gabia (kserver116-27) and is pending PAT sync. This file holds compounds whose champion/convergence/EOS/elastic were directly read from the gabia run dirs and confirmed.
_source: gabia:/data/work/runs/multi_category_2026_05_26_v23/<compound>_<x>/  (cascade git_commit 9ce6ca3, UMA-s-1p1 task=omat, run 2026-06-07). Champion xyz also at gabia:/data/work/repo/db/structures/doping/<compound>_<x>_champion.xyz.

method_notes.score_fields: de_post_anneal = energy/atom vs baseline AFTER anneal (eV/atom, negative = more stable than undoped baseline). dV_anneal_pct = volume change pre->post anneal. converged_post_anneal = champion geometry converged.
method_notes.elastic: UMA-s-1p1 relaxed-ion Cij -> Voigt-Reuss-Hill (B_hill/G_hill = B_VRH/G_VRH); E_VRH = 9BG/(3B+G). Absolute UMA elastic runs HIGH vs experimental AFM/UPE (12-22 GPa) — compare WITHIN cascade (UMA-vs-UMA) only.
method_notes.eos: UMA-s-1p1 Birch-Murnaghan B0 (hydrostatic). Distinct quantity from elastic B_VRH (harmonic Cij); EOS B0 < B_VRH typically (~2x for soft argyrodites).

Al2O3.champion_site: Li_24g (Al3+ -> Li site, DONOR substitution) + O -> S_16e anion site; Li compensated (champion cells 47-48 atoms = base 52 - 7 Li + 2 Al + 3 O approx).

x005._note: softest of the three -> best low-modulus coating candidate

Al2O3.verdict: CLEAN. Al consistently goes to the Li_24g site (donor), O to S_16e, all concentrations converged, formation energy favorable (de < 0, Al-O bonding). Full pipeline 00_preflight..09e_ehull completed. EOS B0 11.5-18.1 GPa (softer than undoped modelc UMA ~20). x005 is the softest (E_VRH 29.3, B0 18.1) -> best fit for the Hyundai low-modulus coating-layer goal. Non-monotonic stiffness across x is champion-config + small-cell UMA noise.
Al2O3.answers_old_question: Confirms 'Al goes to the Li site' (user asked 'Al은 대부분 Li 사이트로 간 건가?') -> YES, Li_24g for all concentrations.
